verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including whether submitted filing data may be used for AI training, is a fair question for any service that collects user data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any privacy control; the items cover only business filing, search and registration functions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
